title: ISC — Monthly Supplier Scorecard
description: Triggers when ISC fires a schedule.monthly_scorecard webhook (1st of each month). Builds an HTML scorecard table from the suppliers array in the payload using Code by Zapier, and emails it to the user. Payload fields are nested under 'data': data.userEmail, data.userName, data.month, data.suppliers, data.supplierCount.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'schedule.monthly_scorecard'.
Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN inside the code. The supplier list, user name, and month all come from the ISC webhook payload (data.suppliers, data.userName, data.month).

settings.subject: {{2__subject}}
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. To = {{1__data__userEmail}} (maps to data.userEmail in the payload). Subject and body come from the Code step output.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap. Choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'schedule.monthly_scorecard'.
3. Add a 'Code by Zapier → Run Javascript' step. Paste the code from step 2 in this file. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN inside the code.
4. Add a Gmail action. Set To = {{1__data__userEmail}}, Subject = {{2__subject}}, Body = {{2__html}}.
6. All payload fields (userEmail, userName, month, suppliers) are nested under 'data' — use {{1__data__userEmail}} etc.
7. ISC fires this on the 1st of each month automatically — no Zapier schedule trigger needed.
